jobs.occupation: Would you like to build data platforms that make a difference across Europe?
jobs.description:
Shape the future of data in an international organization

Do you enjoy building scalable data platforms, designing robust data pipelines, and transforming complex business requirements into reliable data solutions?

At Daka and SARIA, we're strengthening our international data landscape and are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to play a key role in developing the data platform that supports business decisions across Europe.

Working with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Power BI, you will help build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across multiple countries, business units, and operational sites. This is an opportunity to join a growing data organization where you can influence both technical solutions and future architecture while working with modern cloud technologies.

The Role

As our new Data Engineer, you will join the international Data Solutions team and become a key contributor to the development of our next-generation data platform.

You will work across multiple systems, countries, and business areas, ensuring reliable, scalable, and high-quality data flows that support analytics, reporting, and business operations.

This role combines data engineering, architecture, and business understanding. You'll collaborate closely with eight colleagues across Europe, with one colleague based in Hedensted. The BI-team works according to Scrum principles, with stand-ups twice a week to stay aligned, share progress, and address challenges. Just as importantly, you will join a team with an open feedback culture, where colleagues actively help and challenge each other with the shared ambition of making each other better.

The position reports to Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, based in Germany.

Your primary workplace will be our headquarters in Hedensted, Denmark, where you will also be part of our local IT organization consisting of eight colleagues. While your daily home base is Denmark, your projects, stakeholders, and impact will span across Europe.

What You'll Be Working On

You will play a central role in both maintaining and further developing our data platform. Your responsibilities will include:

• Designing and developing scalable data solutions in Azure Databricks

• Building, optimizing, and maintaining modern data pipelines

• Integrating data from ERP systems, operational applications, APIs, databases and cloud platforms

• Developing and maintaining semantic models in Power BI

• Ensuring data quality, reliability, and accessibility across business-critical solutions

• Supporting data architecture decisions and platform improvements

• Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions

• Contributing to documentation, governance, and best practices across the data landscape

Your Technical Toolbox

We expect you to bring experience within several of the following areas:

• Azure Databricks

• PySpark

• SQL

• Data modelling and semantic layers

• Power BI

• APIs and system integrations

• Cloud-based data platforms

• Data architecture and platform design

• ETL/ELT development

• Data quality and governance

You don't need to tick every box, but we expect you to have strong experience within modern data engineering and a genuine interest in building scalable data solutions.

Who You Are

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You take a proactive approach, ask questions, and are comfortable challenging the status quo when you see opportunities to improve the way we work.

You enjoy taking ownership and balancing deep technical work with collaboration across different parts of the business. Working in an international environment with multiple stakeholders energizes you, and you're comfortable communicating technical topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You bring an open-minded, curious, and constructive approach to collaboration. As a senior member of the team, you are also passionate about sharing your knowledge and supporting the development of more junior colleagues.

Additionally, we imagine that you:

• Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field

• Have several years of experience working with data engineering and data platforms

• Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken

• Take a structured and quality-oriented approach to your work

• Thrive in environments where you can influence solutions, challenge existing ways of working, and contribute to continuous improvement

Why Join Daka and SARIA?

This is not a maintenance role. You will join a business where data and digitalization are strategic priorities, and where there is a genuine ambition to strengthen the data platform across the entire organization.

In return, we offer:

• A key position in an international organization with significant growth ambitions

• Opportunity to influence architecture, tools, and future data platform development

• Modern technologies and a cloud-first data environment

• Collaboration with skilled colleagues across Denmark and Europe

• A high degree of autonomy and responsibility

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development

• Flexible working arrangements, including the option to work from home up to two days a week

• An attractive pension scheme with an 11% employer contribution

• 23 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• Lunch programme and attractive employment conditions

Beyond the professional opportunities, you'll become part of a collaborative and down-to-earth culture where people genuinely enjoy working together. From social events and staff association activities to an informal coffee break with colleagues, community is an important part of everyday life at our headquarters in Hedensted.

Interested in joining us?

We look forward to hearing from you. Please submit your CV with a motivated profile summary through the "Apply" link.

The recruitment process consists of two interviews at our headquarters in Hedensted, with Mirco joining online. The first interview focuses on your experience, motivation, and technical skills. The second includes feedback on a personality profile and cognitive assessment.

Due to scheduled holidays, we will begin conducting interviews in November. We look forward to getting to know you then.

If you have questions regarding the role, please contact Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, phone: +49 151 729 33 576.

If you have questions about the Danish team or daily work life, please contact Thorbjørn Kloster, Head of CIO Office, phone: +45 2947 1215.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As Lead IT Auditor at SimCorp, you will be responsible for leading and executing IT audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, information security systems, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. This role involves assessing IT infrastructure, systems, and processes to identify vulnerabilities and areas for improvement. The Lead / Principal IT Auditor works closely with business units and senior leadership to test whether IT risks are managed effectively, and that the organization’s technology systems support its compliance and operational objectives.

In an IT organization like SimCorp, the Lead / Principal IT Auditor promotes collaboration among business, information security, risk management, and Internal Audit. By conducting risk-based audits and identifying relevant issues, the auditor enhances IT governance, risk management, and business resilience, ensuring compliance with policies and industry standards while promoting continuous improvement and accountability

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Lead and execute IT audits across various business units to assess the effectiveness of internal controls and the security of IT systems and infrastructure

• Evaluate IT processes, applications, and systems for compliance with internal policies, regulatory standards, and industry best practices

• Identify and assess IT risks, vulnerabilities, and control gaps, providing actionable recommendations for mitigation and improvement

• Collaborate with IT teams and business units to ensure that audit findings are addressed and corrective actions are implemented effectively

• Prepare detailed audit reports documenting findings, recommendations, and action plans, and present these reports to senior leadership

• Monitor and track the implementation of corrective actions from prior audits to assess improvements implemented by the business and issues are resolved in a timely manner

• Ensure that audits are conducted in alignment with industry standards and regulatory requirements concerning audit of IT-related risks

• Assist in developing audit plans, schedules, and priorities, ensuring audits are conducted in line with organizational objectives

• Assist in developing and refining audit methodologies, tools, and processes to improve IT audit practices

• Stay current on emerging IT risks, regulatory changes, and audit standards to ensure that audit practices remain effective and relevant

• Provide guidance and support to junior auditors, supporting their development in IT auditing and auditing standards

**TYPE OF WORK THIS ROLE ENAGES WITH

**

• Leading IT audits to evaluate IT infrastructure, security, and compliance

• Identifying vulnerabilities and recommending improvements to strengthen IT controls and mitigate risks

• Collaborating with business and IT teams to address audit findings and validate the implemented corrective actions

**What We Value

**

• University degree in Computer Science, Information Security or similar relevant field

• 7+ years of professional experience of practical IT auditing

• Strong cross-domain IT knowledge, including network technology, operating systems, Information Security, SDLC, cloud (MS Azure)

• Solid knowledge of common IT and security standards such as CSA-CCM, ITIL, COBIT, BSI IT Grundschutz, NIST, CIS-18 and ISO/IEC 27000 series

• Relevant professional certification such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or CIA preferred

• High analytical skills, methodical know-how and conceptual understanding of complex matters

• Fluent English and effective interpersonal communication abilities

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click the “Apply” button to learn more about the vacancy and what SimCorp has to offer regarding salary, benefits, and perks. Please note only applications sent through our system will be processed. Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your CV in English as soon as possible.

If you are interested in being part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is a good match, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

By Joining our team, you will have the chance to become part of a thriving company comprising collaborative, curious, courageous, and capable employees Explore a multitude of exciting learning and development opportunities, supported by our unique learning guild Engage with highly skilled and supportive colleagues, each bringing their diverse backgrounds and perspectives Join a company that not only values but actively advocates for Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, cultivating a truly inclusive and empowering environment.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

Do you want to lead highly skilled engineers working with Computer Vision and Machine Learning in products used across the world?

At Dalux, we build software that makes the construction industry smarter and more efficient. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Development Manager to lead teams in our Reality Capture department working with Computer Vision and Machine Learning .

This is a role for someone who combines strong people leadership with solid technical credibility . You do not need to be hands-on in the code every day, but you do need the experience and judgment to lead specialist teams, challenge technical decisions, and help us hire outstanding talent in the field.

The role

As Development Manager, you will be responsible for leading and developing a group of specialists working with Computer Vision and spatial understanding of visual data across our Reality Capture products and platform, including building and scaling performance-critical systems in C++. You will work closely with technical leaders, product leaders, and other managers across Dalux Development.

This is not just a delivery role. You will help build a strong specialist environment where talented engineers can do their best work, grow in their careers, and create meaningful product impact.

At Dalux, Development Managers typically contribute across four areas:

People leadership

You will lead and support your team members in their professional growth, motivation, and performance. You will help create clarity, direction, and engagement in a specialist environment, and you will play an active part in attracting and hiring new colleagues.

Team and engineering enablement

You will help your teams succeed by improving ways of working, removing obstacles, and strengthening collaboration. In a specialist department, that also means creating the right conditions for deep technical work, knowledge sharing, and high engineering quality.

Product and cross-functional collaboration

You will work closely with Product Management, Design, and technical leaders to ensure that our Computer Vision and Machine Learning capabilities are translated into intuitive product features that allow users to navigate, understand, and act on real-world site data. You will help balance technical possibilities, product value, quality, and long-term sustainability.

Organizational development and change

As Dalux continues to grow, many of our leaders contribute beyond their own teams. You may take part in or drive initiatives related to tooling, engineering processes, quality, innovation, technical maturity, or organizational development.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a leader with a background in software development and relevant experience from Computer Vision or similar domains working with visual or spatial data .

Most importantly, you have the technical understanding and leadership maturity to lead highly skilled specialists and help them perform at a high level.

We expect that you have:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

• Experience with development of Computer Vision systems

• Experience taking responsibility in either technical leadership , people leadership , or both

• A passion for helping other people grow and succeed

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical roles

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or applied fields of Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Robotics, Autonomous systems, or similar

• Experience leading specialist teams or senior engineers

• Experience working with spatial data, mapping, or geometry-heavy problems in a product development context

• Experience hiring technical talent in highly specialized fields

• Experience working in empowered product teams or similar collaborative product development setups

What Success Looks Like In The Role

In this role, you will succeed by building a strong and healthy specialist engineering environment. That means:

• Your teams are motivated, growing, and delivering high-quality work

• Collaboration across engineering, product, and design is strong

• The department is able to attract and hire great specialist talent

• Technical depth and product impact reinforce each other

• You help scale both people and practices as Dalux grows

Why join Dalux?

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We create digital tools for the construction industry, and our products are used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

We are proud to develop our products entirely in-house , and we care deeply about engineering quality, modern technology, and building strong teams. At Dalux, you will join an environment with ambitious colleagues, real product impact, and a strong belief that great software is built by empowered people working closely together.

This is an opportunity to take on a meaningful leadership role in a company that is growing fast, while helping shape how specialist engineering capabilities like Computer Vision and Machine Learning create value in real products.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position in Computational Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute
Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

• 
General power electronics and its reliability

• 
Multimaterial additive manufacturing

• 
Printed electronics

• 
Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

• 
Surface and interface engineering

• 
Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

• 
Materials for power electronics

• 
Energy-device manufacturing

• 
Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

• 
An outstanding research and publication track record 

• 
Experience with industrial collaboration

• 
Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

• 
Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

• 
Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

• 
Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

• 
Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

• 
Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

• 
Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

• 
Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

• 
Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

• 
Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

• 
Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
Motivated application. 

• 
Ideas for research and development activities.

• 
Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position. 

• 
Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.occupation: Head of Security Incident Response and Threat Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Join our Security Incident Response and Threat Management Team and take the lead in protecting Danske Bank's critical services across the Nordic region. You will guide a technically strong team through complex threat landscapes while ensuring our customers receive secure, resilient banking services. This role offers the opportunity to shape incident response capabilities in a rapidly evolving digital environment.

**What You Will Be Doing

**As our Security Incident Response Leader, you will lead a team that safeguards banking operations for millions of customers while adapting to cloud and advanced technologies. You will collaborate with technology, business, and risk stakeholders to maintain robust security across the Group.

• Lead and develop a technically skilled incident response and threat management team

• Play a central role in major incident management, leading investigations and making decisions in line with policy, legal requirements and tested processes

• Provide timely briefings to the Chief Security Officer on the status of technical controls, response capabilities and major investigations within your area

• Design and refine incident response processes, runbooks, and playbooks

• Oversee digital forensics to ensure investigations are legally defensible

• Support compliance activities including regulatory requests and audits

• Monitor key performance indicators for detection and containment times

• Foster team growth through mentoring and knowledge sharing

• Coordinate threat intelligence to support tactical and strategic functions

**About You

**

• Minimum 6 years professional experience in cyber security operations

• At least 4 years in daily threat monitoring and response activities

• Minimum 2 years people management or team leadership experience

• Strong understanding of enterprise technologies and security controls

• Ability to communicate clearly with technical and senior stakeholders

• Knowledge of IT risks, controls, and European financial regulations

• Industry certifications such as CISSP, GCIA, GCIH, OSCP, or equivalent

• Experience in financial services or regulated environments would be valuable, along with a master's degree in cyber security, computer science, or related field.

**What We Offer You

**This position can be located both in Lithuania and Denmark. If the position is located in Lithuania the monthly salary range will be from 7040 EUR to 10560 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (benefits are only valid for Lithuania the same as the salary ranges) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits in Lithuania HERE**.

**Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Cyber Security.

We provide a collaborative environment where you can develop cutting-edge security capabilities while leading a talented team. You will work in a hybrid model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote knowledge sharing and team collaboration. We support your professional growth through continuous learning opportunities and career progression within our expanding security function.

If you're interested in this role and joining my team, feel free to contact me - Cliff Kamara via LinkedIn**.** I will be happy to answer your questions.

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

**Senior Software Engineer – join a development team working with telecom, automation and integrations at Adversus A/S in Aarhus.

**_Are you an engineer who can put together an excellent performing application platform on top of a complex system? Do you have a solid feel for software design and system reliability, and the technical chops to bring everything together into one neat package? Then (please) don't shy away and continue reading. This position could be yours!

__Adversus' ambitions are high, our organization is flat, and we always strive to learn and have fun while doing it.

_**Next-gen sales acceleration platform

**Since 2016, Adversus has strived to be a market leader in a competitive field that requires high availability and high uptime. Adversus has experienced exponential growth in recent years, both in demand of the product itself but also the company. Today, we have 70+ employees located at our headquarters in Aarhus.

Adversus' solution is an all-in-one sales acceleration platform that supports our customers' needs for an effective, structured and data-driven daily routine. Delivering an efficient and stable experience with a high level of usability is key to our high user satisfaction.

When spending most of their day on our platform, our users often need deep insights into their data and are always looking for ways to optimize their setup. Our platform unites three different tools: a telecommunications system, an automation system and a CRM system. Because of these many moving parts, our application needs to handle the unexpected and present a solid user experience even when something, somewhere, isn't working.

As our new senior software engineer, you'll be welcomed with open arms by our Development team to deliver the next generation of our software.

**What will you be working with?

**Your primary responsibilities will be implementing new features and services that extend the capabilities of our main application, as well as improving the existing ones. This includes work on our various automation systems, on-demand, large-scale task processing, and keeping our integrations up to date. You will also be expected to work with our frontend application, helping improve some of the technical views and sometimes prototyping new interfaces for new features.

As a senior, you will be expected to see the bigger picture — understanding how individual pieces of work fit into the platform as a whole, and helping the team make good technical decisions along the way. You will naturally take ownership of complex problems, including the genuinely open-ended ones where you're the one figuring out where to start, and reduce their complexity for the rest of the team. You'll take full ownership from scoping to delivery: defining the approach, coordinating with whoever the work touches, and seeing it through, not just the technical parts.

You'll also help junior and mid-level colleagues grow through code reviews, knowledge sharing and day-to-day collaboration. You'll act as a go-to resource for technical decisions and code quality, taking the time to explain your reasoning, not just hand over the answer, and helping people get better at what they do.

You should be deeply familiar with async processing flows, data-driven programming, and be able to implement them confidently on the backend, and on the frontend when the work calls for it.

You should be comfortable working with new technologies, and some very old ones, and be able to hit the ground running on problems where you may not know all the details up front — including ones nobody has fully defined yet, where you're happy to take the first step yourself.

**Our Tech Stack, In Brief

**

• Backend: PHP / MySQL / NodeJS / Redis

• Frontend: React / TypeScript / Tailwind

And some of the extra flavor you will probably end up interacting with:

• Elasticsearch / WebRTC / SignalR / RabbitMQ

**Here Is How We Imagine You

**We are looking for someone with more than 5 years of professional experience as a software engineer, with a strong backend focus. A relevant degree is a plus, but what matters most is that you have the technical chops and experience to genuinely call yourself senior — how you got there matters less than the fact that you did.

You’re a pragmatic problem solver who gets things done: you can dig into an unfamiliar technology or protocol, form a view quickly, and make decisions backed by solid, critical arguments. You’re comfortable committing to a direction without needing every detail up front, and delivering business-critical work on a tight deadline. You have solid experience across our core tech stack and are ready to take on a challenge when it comes to the rest. You have seen enough systems and codebases to know how things can go wrong, and you use that perspective to write better code, spot risk early, and guide others.

You take real ownership of what you work on, and you're just as comfortable picking up a loosely defined problem and figuring out where to start as you are executing against a clear spec. You have a good sense for how the pieces of a system fit together, and you are comfortable being a go-to resource for your colleagues, including helping them grow, without needing a formal leadership title.

You communicate effectively in English – Danish is not a requirement.

As a person, you are disciplined, reliable, and a natural team player. You take ownership and understand how your work contributes to customer outcomes. You are curious about new technologies and unafraid of some old ones. Lastly, you are happy to be part of a humorous, collaborative work environment.

**Our hiring process

****We Keep It Straightforward And Respectful Of Your Time

**

• CV screen — we review your application and reach out for a quick 10 min call for further clarifications

• First interview — a conversation about you, your experience, and the role, preferably in person at our office

• Technical assignment — a practical task to complete in your own time

• Second interview — a technical conversation with our team based on the assignment

**This Is What Adversus Can Offer You.

**We offer you a full-time job with an attractive and competitive salary package to match your qualifications and experience. We recently moved into a newly renovated and decorated office space located right in the heart of Aarhus, so if you value excellent working conditions, we think we got that covered too.

We're pretty flexible about meeting times, but we expect that you are able to come to the office most days of the week, while having the option to take 1-2 work from home days per week if needed.

You will have full health and dental insurance, pension, and an IT setup tailored to your preferences.

We have a Choose Your Own Lunch catering solution, so you never have to go hungry; and plenty of social events like Friday bars, out-of-office gatherings, and summer parties.

Salary and terms of employment are negotiated individually.

Join us in this role where you’ll manage key insurance activities across the organisation, respond to changing risk exposures, and help ensure appropriate coverage in line with our insurance policy. You’ll coordinate day-to-day delivery, renewals, tenders, and projects while working closely with colleagues, insurers, and brokers.

**Welcome to Group Risk:

**You’ll be part of Insurance where you, together with your colleagues, will support business units, companies, and regions and manage insurance for the organisation’s global risks. The team consists of seven specialists, primarily based in Gentofte, with two colleagues in London. As a team, we share expertise, take responsibility, and help each other deliver high-quality solutions.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• managing local Danish insurance arrangements, including motor, workers’ compensation, and accident insurance

• coordinating global employee-related insurance programmes for international assignments and business travel

• handling daily enquiries, annual renewals, and relevant tender activities with internal and external stakeholders

• supporting insurance activities for power generation, pipeline, and storage operations, including communication with the business

• coordinating insurance-related technology tasks and contributing to the implementation and continuous improvement of the insurance management system

• leading or contributing to projects in the Insurance team, preparing documents and presentations, and maintaining effective administrative controls.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have an experience with corporate insurance, insurance broking, or a related risk and insurance role

• understand employee-related insurance programmes and have experience with, or a strong interest in, property insurance

• can manage renewals, tenders, enquiries, documentation, and multiple stakeholders with attention to quality and detail

• communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English in an international working environment

• feel comfortable using Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, and can work with business systems such as SAP and SharePoint

• work independently, collaborate openly, take initiative, and stay effective in a changing environment.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr45,000.00- kr65,000.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

We are seeking a strategic and solutions-oriented Director, Creative Operations to lead the operational backbone of our in-house creative team. As a key leader within the organization, you will be responsible for driving efficiency, optimizing workflows, and enabling the seamless delivery of creative work for a global audience.

This role will lead project management, creative operations systems, technology enablement, and external agency partnerships to ensure our teams deliver best-in-class creative work at scale. You will collaborate closely with Digital & Technology, Brand, Marketing, and Production teams to shape and evolve the creative operating model, lead technology initiatives, and identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, and efficiency through automation and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized and collaborative leader with deep expertise in creative operations, workflow transformation, technology implementation, and change management. You are equally comfortable developing long-term operational strategies and ensuring day-to-day execution excellence.

Creative Operations & Project Management

• 
Lead the Creative Studio operating model, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, resource allocation, and project delivery.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of creative workflows, systems, and governance across project management, DAM, and MRM platforms.

• 
Partner with Creative, Brand, Marketing Operations, Production, and Technology teams to align priorities, optimize resources, and ensure successful delivery.

• 
Establish operational KPIs and reporting to measure workflow effectiveness, resource utilization, delivery performance, and business impact.

• 
Lead and develop Creative Operations capabilities through coaching, best practices, and process excellence.

Technology, AI & Operational Excellence

• 
Partner with Digital & Technology teams to evaluate, select, and implement creative technology solutions, including DAM, workflow, automation, and AI-enabled tools.

• 
Develop business cases and investment plans that improve creative effectiveness, operational efficiency, and scalability.

• 
Establish governance, adoption frameworks, and responsible-use practices for AI and emerging technologies.

• 
Monitor industry trends and translate innovation into practical improvements across creative operations and content production.

Agency & Vendor Management

• 
Lead relationships with external design, localization, customization, and technology partners, ensuring alignment with brand, quality, budget, and delivery expectations.

• 
Manage SOWs, contracts, performance metrics, and ongoing vendor effectiveness.

• 
Evaluate partner capabilities and identify opportunities to leverage innovation, automation, and emerging production models.

Change Management & Transformation

• 
Lead change initiatives that enable successful adoption of new technologies, processes, and ways of working.

• 
Drive continuous improvement and build organizational capability in creative operations, technology adoption, and operational excellence.

• 
Influence stakeholders across the business to deliver sustainable transformation and measurable impact.

Budget & Resource Management

• 
Own budget planning for Creative Operations systems, technology investments, and operational needs in partnership with the Head of Production.

• 
Forecast and optimize resource allocation across internal teams and external partners.

• 
Partner with Finance and Production to monitor spend, measure ROI, and drive efficiency across people, processes, and technology.

Qualifications & Experience

• 
Significant experience in Creative Operations, Project Management, Marketing Operations, or workflow transformation within an in-house agency, creative organization, or related environment.

• 
Experience leading or shaping creative operations functions, operating models, or large-scale transformation initiatives.

• 
Expertise in enterprise project management, DAM, MRM, workflow management, and collaboration platforms (e.g., Workfront, Asana, Wrike, Bynder, Aprimo, or similar).

• 
Experience evaluating, implementing, and scaling AI-enabled or automation solutions within creative, marketing, or operational environments.

• 
Experience leading RFPs, developing business cases, and delivering technology implementations in partnership with Digital & Technology teams.

• 
Strong understanding of creative workflows across design, content production, localization, and asset management.

• 
Demonstrated success managing agency and vendor partnerships, including localization, customization, and technology providers.

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and change leadership skills.

• 
Proven ability to drive adoption of new technologies and ways of working across complex organizations.

• 
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.

• 
Experience with budget planning, financial management, and investment prioritization.

• 
Passion for leveraging technology, automation, and innovation to improve creative effectiveness and operational excellence.

Reports to: VP Brand Creative

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Creative Operations at Pandora. You will play a critical role in building the processes, systems, and capabilities that enable exceptional creative work at a global scale. Working across Brand Creative, Production, Marketing, and Technology, you will help define how creativity is delivered in a modern, technology-enabled organization while driving meaningful impact across the business.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Are you a curious software developer who enjoys taking ownership and exploring new technologies? At Evosep, you’ll have the opportunity to develop software that supports innovative technologies within protein-based clinical diagnostics. You’ll work on everything from instrument control to the systems supporting our production. You’ll collaborate with passionate colleagues and have the freedom to explore modern approaches such as AI-assisted and agentic development. Most importantly, you’ll be joining a team where your ideas and desire to make a real difference matters. Does this sound like you? Then we'd love to hear from you.

What We Do

Evosep aims to improve quality of life and patient care by radically innovating protein based clinical diagnostics. Making sample preparation and separation

before MS analysis 10 times faster and 100 times more robust will enable truly large cohort studies for biomarker validation and provide the foundation for

precision medicine.

Key Tasks and responsibilities

• Design and develop software solutions that support both current and next-generation Evosep technologies, including software for instrument control, internal production support systems etc.

• Maintain, improve, and support existing and legacy Evosep software systems.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies, development practices, and methodologies, and explore how they can add value to our solutions.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive cando attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. To be successful in this role, you should also ideally bring:

• A couple of years of professional software development experience.

• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• Enthusiastic about AI-assisted and agentic software development

• A strong sense of ownership and responsibility for tasks and products.

• Experience with C#, C/C++, Lua, and/or Python.

• Experience with firmware development and/or IoT.

• Knowledge of cyber resilience and secure software development.

• Experience working with agile development practices.

• Strong written and spoken English skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly.

• A proactive, curious, and collaborative mindset, with the motivation to contribute to a fast-moving international team.

What We Offer

• A team of passionate, ambitious, and supporting colleagues with a can-do mentality and a strong belief in our ability to make a real difference with what we do.

• An innovative, open, and dynamic culture where we continuously learn and develop.

• The possibility to join a rapidly growing company in the life science industry where you will contribute to solutions for improving quality of life and

patient care.

• A competitive benefits package and lunch arrangement.

• Flexible work hours and work-life balance.

• New, modern office facilities in Odense.

• The list goes on, learn more about us on www.evosep.com/careers.

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

What Happens After I Send My Application?

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible. We will conduct interviews continuously and we reserve the right to close the job advert as soon as the position has been filled, so do not hesitate to send us an application. It is important to us that we respond to all candidates who have spent time sending us an application and you will always as a minimum receive an email with a response once the hiring process is over.

Living in Odense

Join a thriving life science ecosystem with strong university-industry collaboration and exciting career opportunities. Discover why professionals from around the world choose to live and work in Odense - a city that combines innovation, work-life balance, and exceptional quality of life. Learn more here Career in Odense - Invest in Odense. If you are relocating from abroad, International House Odense offers practical support to help you settle in and navigate life in Denmark

jobs.occupation: Test Method Specialist, Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory
jobs.description:
Imagine if robust test methods and reliable test equipment helped ensure the quality of both new and existing Coloplast products. That is where you come in.

As our new Test Method Specialist, you will become the technical focal point for selected test methods and related equipment in Coloplast Mørdrup, primarily supporting the QA Lifecycle Laboratory and Pilot SVS. This is a practical, hands-on specialist role in which you will work directly with laboratory equipment, including troubleshooting, service and calibration follow-up, qualification, and software and computer upgrades. You will support the full test method and equipment lifecycle, from implementation and qualification to maintenance, transfer and continuous improvement.

If you are motivated by hands-on technical problem-solving, equipment responsibility, quality assurance and data evaluation, this role offers meaningful responsibility and broad organisational impact. You will also work closely with many internal and external stakeholders, making clear communication, coordination and strong stakeholder management an important part of your success.

“In this role, your technical judgement and ability to create robust solutions will help ensure reliable test results and compliant laboratory processes throughout the product lifecycle,” says Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory.

Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

At our Coloplast Mørdrup site, you will join the Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory. The team consists of laboratory technicians and test method specialists who work closely together to support ongoing production, process development, quality investigations and test method activities.

You will be part of an engaged team with a strong mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, Operations, Global Test Method teams and international manufacturing sites. We value curiosity, knowledge sharing, flexibility and a continuous improvement mindset.

Own and develop test methods and equipment

As Test Method Specialist, you will act as a one-point contact and technical superuser for selected test methods and test equipment. A significant part of the role is practical equipment responsibility. You will work hands-on with equipment and coordinate activities to ensure it is qualified, calibrated, serviced, maintained and performing as intended. You will also support software and computer upgrades connected to the equipment, as well as reliable data handling and traceability.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•    Acting as technical owner and one-point contact for selected test methods and related test equipment

•    Planning, coordinating and performing qualification of test equipment, including relocation, capacity expansion and replacement of critical parts

•    Preparing and maintaining qualification protocols, reports, procedures, test method documentation and one-point lessons when needed

•    Performing hands-on troubleshooting of test equipment and methods, evaluating test results and leading root cause investigations when failures occur

•    Taking practical responsibility for test equipment, including service activities, calibration follow-up, preventive maintenance and ensuring that equipment performs as intended

•    Handling changes, nonconformities and CAPAs related to test methods, calibration and test equipment

•    Supporting compliant storage and traceability of raw data before product release

•    Planning and participating in transfers of test methods and equipment to international manufacturing sites

•    Providing technical support and sparring to colleagues in the Pilot Plant, Global Operations and international manufacturing sites

•    Collaborating with Global Test Method teams and contributing technical input to the development and improvement of test methods

•    Training specialists, laboratory technicians, operators and other users in test methods, test principles and use of equipment

•    Coordinating software and computer upgrades for test equipment, assessing their impact on qualification and documentation, and managing suppliers, service visits and relevant service agreements

•    Participating in internal and external audits related to test methods, equipment and documentation

•    Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, systems and ways of working

Bring strong technical judgement and a quality mindset

To succeed in this position, you combine technical depth with a structured, practical and hands-on approach. You enjoy working directly with equipment, take ownership and work systematically when resolving technical issues. You are comfortable making decisions based on data, risk and regulatory requirements.

The role involves close collaboration with many internal and external stakeholders, therefor you communicate clearly, coordinate effectively and are able to build strong working relationships across functions, sites and suppliers.

We imagine that you bring:

•   A master’s degree within science, engineering, mechanics, physics, chemistry, pharmacy or a comparable technical field, or have at least five years of relevant experience with test methods

•   Solid hands-on experience with test methods, measurement principles and qualification of laboratory or production test equipment

•   Strong problem-solving skills and experience with structured root cause analysis

•   Confident evaluating, analysing and presenting technical data skills, including the use of statistical methods

•   Ability to write, review and understand technical documentation, protocols and reports

•   Knowledge of quality systems and regulated environments; knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 and GMP is an advantage

•   An understanding of validation, calibration, design control, specifications and process risk management

•   Abitlity to plan and prioritise your work effectively and follow activities through to completion

•   Strong stakeholder management skills and collaborate effectively across disciplines, functions, geographical locations and external suppliers

•    Communicating skills professionally in English, both written and spoken; Danish is an advantage

•    A comfortable competence using digital tools for documentation, data analysis and traceability; experience with Microsoft Office, Veeva, JMP or similar systems is an advantage

A specialist role with broad impact

This is a permanent specialist position in the QA Lifecycle Laboratory. The role has no direct reports and includes collaboration with international colleagues and manufacturing sites. Some travel may be expected in connection with transfers, supplier activities and site support.

You will join a working environment where quality, safety, technical excellence, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to our daily work. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network and influence how test methods and equipment are managed across the product lifecycle.

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Lotte Stoklund, Team Manager, QA Lifecycle Laboratory, at dklst@coloplast.com.

We invite candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to submit your CV with a description of your motivation for applying, as soon as possible.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a software developer in our turbine software team, you will play a key role in developing the embedded software that controls wind turbines. Your day will involve close collaboration with team members and stakeholders from around the world, working through the full software development lifecycle—from requirements clarification and implementation to testing and maintenance. You’ll contribute to innovative projects, participate in agile SCRUM teams, and help ensure our solutions are robust, secure, and high-performing. With a flexible work environment, you’ll have the opportunity to balance independent tasks with teamwork, both in the office and remotely.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• 
Develop and maintain control software in C++ for Linux-based embedded systems, ensuring reliable operation of wind turbines.

• 
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.

• 
Conduct comprehensive software testing, including unit, integration, and acceptance tests, employing strong CI/CD practices and AI-assisted programming.

• 
Refactor and enhance existing code to maintain fleet performance and participate in innovation initiatives such as code camps and ideation events.

• 
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by following agile development principles within a SCRUM and SAFe environment.

What You Bring

• 
Academic degree in IT, Software, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in C/C++ software development.

• 
Proficiency in object-oriented programming, software testing, continuous integration, embedded control mechanisms, and middleware development for Linux-based x86 and ARM platforms, including Linux system hardening for cyber-security.

• 
A keen interest in control of mechanical areas such as aerodynamics, mechanics, hydraulics, and power electronics, with a passion for integrating hardware and software into safe, high-quality solutions.

• 
Experience working with real-time protocols (e.g., ProfiNet), version control systems (Git), task management tools (Jira), and agile development methodologies such as SCRUM and SAFe.

• 
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a structured and proactive approach, an ownership mindset, and a passion for delivering high-quality software solutions in the renewable energy sector.

You’ll join a diverse and innovative team dedicated to advancing renewable energy through pioneering software solutions. We value collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning, working together in an agile environment to drive the success of our wind turbine projects. Our team thrives on mutual support, open communication, and a shared commitment to making a positive impact on the world.

At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines, so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior IoT Solutions Engineer to join Engineering Services, the team that takes on the technical problems that fall outside what our product and Support handle today. You’ll look at a PLC, a sensor, or a 20-year-old CNC and work out how to get its data into Factbird. Sales and Support turn to you when the answer is “it depends,” and you turn that into a clear yes, no, or “here’s how.” Then you write it down so the next person doesn’t need to ask.

About the role

Engineering Services solves the hardest technical problems, documents them, and shares the knowledge, so Factbird gets smarter and the same problem doesn’t come back. You’ll answer feasibility questions before deals close, design and build custom solutions, and fix the cross-domain problems no other team can place.

**

The team mission we are on:** Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

What You'll Do

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

About you

You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

The Senior AI Adoption Lead takes ownership of ALK's continuous AI adoption programme, turning enthusiasm into real, safe, everyday value from the AI tools available to ALK employees. This role continues the adoption efforts from 2025 (over 1,000 employees trained in GenAI usage) and 2026 (more tailored training on ALK's AI solutions) and is key to achieving ALK's AI ambition within the Allergy+ strategy.

This role requires genuine enthusiasm for enabling people, facilitating great learning experiences, and driving change. The Senior AI Adoption Lead must work closely with people across all business areas, be proactive, reach out to employees, and drive AI adoption across the entire organization so that the change is permanent and sticks with employees.

This role owns ALK's continuous AI adoption programme, covering general enablement on GenAI, tailored upskilling for all employees, and engagement activities that drive adoption. This includes preparing and hosting AI training (both general-purpose and tool-specific), the training calendar, micro-learning, maintaining AI at ALK intranet site. The role also owns measuring GenAI usage across the organization, providing the data needed to support informed decisions in AI strategy implementation.

This is not an engineering role – the person does not need to build or configure AI solutions. It does, however, require basic understanding of both business and IT, so the Senior AI Adoption Lead can act as an effective bridge between the two. Genuine enthusiasm for new technologies, especially generative AI, is required. Experience with usage of those technologies in daily life and enterprise scenario is vital.

The Senior AI Adoption Lead acts as a proxy between business and IT: translating technical concepts into everyday business language, aligning business demand with IT delivery, triaging common issues, and accelerating adoption before escalation to IT.

This role is based in Denmark, where ALK has its headquarters and the majority of AI users. It also requires occasional business travel to conduct in-person workshops and training.

Major fields of responsibility:

• 
Communicate the need for AI adoption through meetings, newsletters, MS Teams, and Intranet; share success stories, best practices, and enthusiasm for upcoming initiatives.

• 
Foster engagement through targeted workshops for departments and business units, regular manager briefings, tailored communications, and a visible emphasis on the benefits of AI in daily work.

• 
Map use cases and design training courses (e.g. Foundations, Advanced Prompting, Leading with GenAI) and micro-learning, and activate and coordinate a network of AI Champions to extend reach.

• 
Provide accessible, tiered learning resources through the AI community and Learning Hub (Teams channel, SharePoint) — videos, live webinars, in-person workshops, quick-start guides, FAQs, and playbooks.

• 
Support enterprise-AI pilots with onboarding, enablement and value evaluation; collect feedback and resolve common non-technical issues; and maintain a tight feedback loop with IT on platform updates, governance, and support to keep adoption aligned and safe.

• 
Work side by side with the technical teams (programmers, architects, data and platform specialists): take part in solution and roadmap discussions, learn how the solutions work, ask questions from the end-user perspective, challenge and advise on usability, and translate the outcome into layman terms for the business.

• 
Define and measure adoption rates and satisfaction (usage, surveys, focus groups) and report impact to leadership; run iterative cycles to refine training content based on user feedback and business priorities; and recognize high adopters through awards and acknowledgment.

Qualifications:

• 
Minimum 10 years' experience in change management, IT systems adoption, and training management and delivery

• 
Proven facilitation, training and change-management experience

• 
Outstanding communication and stakeholder skills across all levels

• 
Fluent in English.

• 
Hands-on curiosity about generative AI

• 
Practical experience with creation of AI assistants (e.g. custom skills in Anthropic Claude or custom agents in M365 Copilot).

• 
Analytical mindset able to translate adoption data into actionable insights.

• 
Self-driven, organized and creative, comfortable working across business and IT**.**
